_note: Where each shipped recitation starts saying the text, and which lines it says, taken by ear. `seconds` is how far into the recording the first word of the text is spoken -- several of these open with an invocation the text does not carry, and the warp is anchored at the start, so without this the whole alignment reads early. `lines` are the 1-based line ranges the recitation actually covers, for a recording that leaves out a stretch: lines outside them keep their text and get no timing, so they read and are never highlighted. Nothing is cut from any recording.
